extraction.method: manual LLM read of auto-captions (data/transcripts/CxKMqO36DdM.txt) over the gameplay window 17:48-1:43:25, plus targeted video frame sampling (yt-dlp --download-sections + ffmpeg stills) for seat placards, card popups (Jeska's Will, Harnfel Horn of Bounty, Lion's Eye Diamond, Boseiju, Kraum), and life totals

games.win_method: Dallas wins the counter-war over his own Voice of Victory turn (his Mindbreak Trap exiles Alan's Force of Will and Chord of Calling plus Sterling's Borne Upon a Wind), then goes off: Badlands land drop, Jeska's Will for 38 red mana off Alan's ~38-card hand, a wheel effect, Harnfel Horn of Bounty filtering, Lion's Eye Diamond into Underworld Breach through heavy Rhystic Study / Mystic Remora taxes (players call it 'the most expensive breach line ever'), recasting Jeska's Will and Deflecting Swat from the graveyard, and shows Brain Freeze at storm ~40; opponents concede (fist bumps at 1:43:21).

games.commentator_review: Armchair review at 101:14-103:00: (1) Alan casting Voice of Victory and passing 'basically said answer me or die' and fueled everything that followed; casting Thrasios and holding Tithe mana was the better line. (2) Sterling's Borne Upon a Wind on top of the giant stack was 'a little greedy'; the green light for a flash enabler is opponents passing on silence effects, and too many spells sat between him and the Voice.
